intuition: Parentheses create nested expressions, while a running sign lets each signed number contribute directly to the current result.

brute_force.approach: Recursively parse every parenthesized substring and evaluate its operators.

optimal.approach: Scan once, accumulate multi-digit numbers, and save the outer result and sign on a stack at each opening parenthesis.

edge_cases: A unary sign can precede a parenthesized expression.
Nested parentheses restore the enclosing result and sign when closed.
